title: Certificates of Deposit: partial early withdrawal and credited-interest withdrawal limits by tier
content:
## Scope

This card covers, for every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line, whether part of the principal may be taken out before maturity and within what limits, and whether interest already credited in the current term may be withdrawn without penalty.

## Definitions

- **Partial early withdrawal allowed** states whether part of the principal may be withdrawn before maturity.
- **Smallest partial withdrawal** is the smallest early partial withdrawal accepted, in USD, or "not applicable".
- **Principal that must remain** is the principal that must remain after an early partial withdrawal, in USD, or "not applicable".
- **Most partial withdrawals per term** is the most early partial withdrawals allowed in one term, as a count.
- **Credited interest withdrawable without penalty** states whether interest already credited during the current term may be withdrawn without penalty.

## Limits by tier

| Tier | Partial early withdrawal allowed | Smallest partial withdrawal (USD) | Principal that must remain (USD) | Most partial withdrawals per term | Credited interest withdrawable without penalty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | 0 | No |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | No | Not applicable | Not applicable | 0 | Yes |
| 12-Month Certificate | Yes | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2 | Yes |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | Yes | 500.00 | 2500.00 | 2 | Yes |
| 36-Month Certificate | Yes | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2 | Yes |
| 60-Month Certificate | Yes | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2 | Yes |

## Points of judgement

**Which tiers allow no partial early withdrawal at all?**
The 6-Month Certificate and the 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate: partial early withdrawal is not allowed, the count per term is 0, and the amount limits are not applicable.

**Where does the remaining-principal floor differ?**
The 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate requires 2500.00 USD to remain after a partial withdrawal; the 12-Month, 36-Month and 60-Month Certificates require 1000.00 USD.

**Is a partial withdrawal of exactly 500.00 USD within the smallest-withdrawal limit on the 36-Month Certificate?**
Yes. The limit is a smallest accepted amount of 500.00 USD, so 500.00 meets it and 499.99 does not.

**Can the owner of a 6-Month Certificate take out credited interest without penalty?**
No. The 6-Month Certificate is the only tier on which credited interest is not withdrawable without penalty.

## Hypothetical tier comparison

A hypothetical owner holds, on each of two tiers, a certificate with 3000.00 USD of principal and asks for a 600.00 USD partial withdrawal. The requested withdrawal takes the principal down to 2400.00 USD on both. That figure is well above the 1000.00 USD floor of the 12-Month Certificate, but below the 2500.00 USD floor of the 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate.
